name: Chaos Sea (classic)
author: Joakim
description: The marker/dead-reckoning chaos-sea stepper, frozen at its long-proven pre-GMCP state - for 3K-3Kingdoms and any character or world without GMCP (needs the '=S='/'=M='/'=P' display settings and MIP for combat truth). Alias 'csc', so it loads beside the GMCP 3s-chaossea ('cs') without a fight. Maps rooms on a 3D grid by dead reckoning, queues unexplored exits, BFS-walks to the nearest frontier room; auto mode fights mobs on the way. Frozen legacy: bugfixes only - new features go to the GMCP bot.
